Tom (Arkwave): I can send the dispute email from our billing@arkwave.com and attach traffic snapshots by EOD. Payment of $7,450 via ACH today is doable.
Marcus - Collections: Collections can pause escalation if partials clear. We'll need payment reference and a firm follow-up date. Also want a note that card fallback remains authorized.
Nina Lee: OK. Terms: accept $7,450 today (mark partial), dispute $6,400 pending reconciliation, final $1,050 will be held pending outcome of the usage review. If dispute is resolved in your favor we'll credit; if not, remaining amount is due on 2026-05-05. Please confirm approval and wire/ACH details.
